steps.caption: Open More in the sidebar, then Lease radar.
Verified dates come from the lease; 'calculated by radar' dates are formulas, never treated as verified.
Buckets: needs review, notice in 90 days, expiring in 0–3, 3–12, 12–24 months…
…expired but not confirmed, and dates unknown. Each shows how many leases are in it.
Start with notice deadlines in the next 90 days — the most urgent.
Each lease: tenant, building, landlord, area, and a call-window status.
Expiry, lock-in end and notice-by, each with days left.
Under each date: where it came from — contractual, or calculated (formula shown).
Reverse plan: working back from the move date — warns when the decision date has passed.
See all leases, then search one tenant, building or landlord.
Click the tenant to open the company and act on it.
